name: Toxtricity
description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Acid
moves.description: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Belch
moves.description: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

moves.name: Noble Roar
moves.description: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Nuzzle
moves.description: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Tearful Look
moves.description: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Overdrive
moves.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

moves.name: Boomburst
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.

moves.name: Shift Gear
moves.description: The user rotates its gears, boosting its Attack stat and sharply boosting its Speed stat.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Poison Tail
moves.description: The user hits the target with its tail. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also poison the target.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

moves.name: Sludge Wave
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those it hits.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Hex
moves.description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Trailblaze
moves.description: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Psychic Noise
moves.description: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
